What you get: Stock physically moves to staging at the source..

Warehousing

Task 4 of 7 in Warehouse transfer · next: Ship

Screen Warehousing➔Outbound/Inspections➔Picking List

Walk itone step at a time · 5 steps

Nobody has confirmed this task in LN yet. Walk it to say, at each step, whether it matched.

Steps

  1. Check the Picking List row recorded in Confirm the processing path and create advice
    You should see If absent or already finished automatically, record Automatic / not applicable and skip steps 2–5; if Automatic = No, continue
  2. Find the Run for this order
    You should see The line for your item and source warehouse
  3. Tick the line
  4. Pick Run

    Actions➔Pick Run

    You should see Stock moves from the source location to staging. Picked fills on Outbound Lines
  5. Record the Run number from the header
    You should see picking list Run number

  • Picking is an activity only for a location-controlled warehouse, and a manual step only where the procedure says so; otherwise Picked fills without confirmation. The mechanics are the same session and actions as a sales pick, on the transfer's own outbound line.

    • No Run appears on the Picking List

      If the order already advanced, record Automatic / not observed. Otherwise, picking may not apply or advice was not generated; return to Confirm the processing path and create advice

    • Screen

      Picking List whinh4525m100
      Confirms an advised quantity as picked, where picking is an activity in the warehousing procedure.
